title: docs: drop docs-site guides table to avoid duplicate links
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed the duplicate seven-guide table from the docs-site introduction; readers can use the existing sidebar to jump to guides. The README keeps its guide table for GitHub readers, and the generated API reference now copies that table from the README. The sync test compares the README’s guide names with the plain-text guide list instead of the docs introduction.
